evidence.claim: 'Boring financial stocks' were green on the crash day and the crash week — named rotation destination

evidence.source: Adam Khoo — Will Rising Long Term Rates Crash Stocks? (Sep 14)
evidence.claim: Banks and insurers outperform as long rates rise: net interest margin expands (DBS/OCBC/UOB, JPM), insurers reinvest float at higher yields (Arch Capital ACGL), ICE earns margin interest and rides rising energy-futures volume
evidence.relation: rising long rates → NIM and float-income expansion for financials

resolution: Agrees with rotation prior (rate curve steepening + value rotation). Second, independent leg (Sep-14 NIM/float mechanism) now supports the same up-direction as the rotation flow evidence; no conflict.
